training_and_exposure.historical_record: Source-aware public data. Limited schema/header and first-row previews recorded before task freeze; any inspected examples remain explicitly exposed. Confirmation performance withheld until selection and stopping freeze.

findings.statement: A compact calibrated utilization predictor transfers to the reserved system set, with substantial residual error and workload dependence.
findings.applicability: Self-selected published MLPerf submissions; quality99.9 aliases removed and inferred results excluded. Different task families, software and latency constraints confound mechanism. No hardware causal efficiency ranking. Reserved mean error is much larger than development error, reflecting difficult system-scale transfer. Several workload logits contact bounds; coefficients are not universal efficiencies. Offline calibration is mandatory, so this is not prediction from specifications alone.
findings.limitations: Reserved mean error is much larger than development error, reflecting difficult system-scale transfer. Several workload logits contact bounds; coefficients are not universal efficiencies. Offline calibration is mandatory, so this is not prediction from specifications alone.
findings.falsification: Reserved mean error is much larger than development error, reflecting difficult system-scale transfer. Several workload logits contact bounds; coefficients are not universal efficiencies. Offline calibration is mandatory, so this is not prediction from specifications alone.
findings.prior_art: The source studies and domain constructions are disclosed in PRIOR_ART.json. This campaign does not certify broad novelty.
